scope: Theorem 8.30 (Identification of local passage laws) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 94. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix γ ∈ [ √ 2, 2) and λ > 1. Let a family of local passage laws satisfy Definition 8.2 and the reference metric inputs stated above. Suppose a law in this family has a finite positive deterministic optimal upper comparison 0 < C < ∞, with its comparison bounds retained at its fixed quantum offsets and further extractions. Then its optimal lower comparison equals C, and FU (x, y) = CDh(x, y; U) on every ordinary open chart U, with compact confinement and exhaustion as above. The multiplier C is deterministic for the entire joint law. This theorem gives no estimate for a prescribed discrete endpoint.
